```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
require(maps)
require(viridis)
```

```{r}
covid_19_data <- read.csv(url("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/datasets/covid-19/master/data/time-series-19-covid-combined.csv"))
# Explicar que pasa aqui
```

```{r}
head(covid_19_data)
# Explicar que pasa aqui
```
```{r}
mexico <- subset(covid_19_data, Country.Region=="Mexico")
head(mexico)
# Explicar que pasa aqui
```
```{r}
str(mexico)
# Explicar que pasa aqui
```
```{r}
mexico$Date <-as.Date(mexico$Date, "%Y-%m-%d")
# Explicar que pasa aqui
```

```{r}
grafica_mexico <- ggplot(mexico, aes(Date, Confirmed, label = Confirmed)) + geom_point()+
geom_line() + geom_text( hjust = "right")
grafica_mexico
# Explicar que pasa aqui
```
```{r}
grafica_mexico <- ggplot(mexico, aes(x = Date)) + geom_line(aes(y = Confirmed, color =
"steelblue")) + geom_line(aes(y = Recovered ), color = "springgreen4", linetype = "twodash") +
geom_line(aes(y = Deaths ), color = "darkred", linetype = "dotted")+ theme_minimal()
grafica_mexico
# Explicar que pasa aqui
```
```{r}
grafica_mexico <- ggplot(mexico, aes(Date, log10(Confirmed ), label = log10(Confirmed ) )) +
geom_point()+ geom_line() + geom_text(hjust = "right", size = 1.0)
grafica_mexico
# Explicar que pasa aqui
```
```{r}
grafica_mexico <- ggplot(mexico, aes(x = Date)) + geom_line(aes(y = log10(Confirmed), color =
"steelblue")) + geom_line(aes(y = log10(Recovered) ), color = "springgreen4", linetype =
"twodash") + geom_line(aes(y = log10(Deaths) ), color = "darkred", linetype = "dotted")+
theme_minimal()
grafica_mexico
# Explicar que pasa aqui
```
```{r}
# Al igual que el Coronavirus COVID-19 Global Cases by the Center for Systems Science and Engineering (CSSE) at Johns Hopkins University, crearemos un mapa con los datos de casos confirmados en todo el mundo
world_map <- map_data("world")
# extrae toda la informacion de georeferencia que hay de todo el globo y con ggplot puedes generar un mapa
```

```{r}
world_map <- map_data("world")
head(world_map)
# Explicar que pasa aqui
```

```{r}
world_map <- map_data("world")
ww_map<-ggplot(world_map, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group)) +
geom_polygon(fill="lightgray", colour = "white")
ww_map
# Explicar que pasa aqui
```

```{r}
ultimo_dia_datos = mexico[nrow(mexico),]$Date
ultimo_dia_datos
# Explicar que pasa aqui
```

```{r}
covid_19_data$Date <- as.Date(covid_19_data$Date, "%Y-%m-%d")
datos_paises <- subset(covid_19_data, Date==ultimo_dia_datos)
(datos_paises)
# Explicar que pasa aqui
```

```{r}
install.packages("stringr")
library("stringr")
```

```{r}
datos_paises <- datos_paises %>%
  mutate(Country.Region = recode(str_trim(Country.Region),
                                  "US" = "USA",
                                  "United Kingdom" = "UK"))
# Explicar que pasa aqui
```

```{r}
china <-datos_paises %>% subset(Country.Region=="China")
china
# Explicar que pasa aqui
```

```{r}
datos_paises <- datos_paises %>% group_by(Country.Region) %>% summarise(Confirmed =
sum(Confirmed, na.rm = TRUE))
datos_paises
```

```{r}
datos_mapa_confirmados <- inner_join(world_map, datos_paises, by = c("region" =
"Country.Region" ))
head(datos_mapa_confirmados)
# Explicar que pasa aqui
```
